messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: High queuing on inference-router-2. 95th latency increased to 2.4s for /v1/generate; queue depth spike on batcher (avg batch wait 120ms). link: https://monitoring/redwood/alerts/INC-4921
Clara M.: seeing same in traces, most traffic is embeddings/bulk from a single customer trying a large reindex. Not yet seeing error responses, but tail latency is bad.
Jamal (oncall): pinging infra and paging priya. I'll start mitigation.
Jamal (oncall): quick ask — do we prefer to throttle that customer or change batch params live? tradeoff: throttling = immediate reduction in queuing, but breaks their job; batching changes = smoother but might increase per-request latency.
Priya R.: @Jamal I'd prefer staged mitigations: 1) apply soft rate limit to embeddings/bulk (reduce QPS by 5x) 2) make batcher aggressive for latency-critical routes (lower batch_window_ms) 3) move that customer's traffic to background tier with higher batching.
Leo G.: +1. We should also disable prefetch-heavy feature on that route (kv-prefetch) to reduce GC pressure.
Sasha: FYI that customer is on Dedicated-north-1, but routed through hosted routing for burst. We can shape at the proxy layer.
Jamal (oncall): I'm going to put the plan into action. I'll post each command.
Jamal (oncall): Applying soft quota on customer org "ACME-ops" for embeddings/bulk (reduce to 20% of current).
Jamal (oncall): /ops-cli quota apply --org ACME-ops --route embeddings/bulk --qps 25 --burst 50 --reason "live mitigation: reduce batch growth"
infra-bot: Command accepted. Quota change queued to control-plane (txn 0x9a3f).
Clara M.: seeing immediate drop in queue depth on router-2, batch wait down to ~40ms. tail latency still elevated but improving.
Priya R.: Next: adjust batcher config for latency-critical routes. Lower continuous_batch.window_ms from 80 -> 20 for routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat/completions. Keep embeddings routes at higher window for throughput.
Priya R.: patch to batcher service:
```
PATCH /api/v1/config/batcher
{
  "overrides": [
    { "route": "/v1/generate", "continuous_batching": { "window_ms": 20, "max_batch_tokens": 1024 } },
    { "route": "/v1/chat/completions", "continuous_batching": { "window_ms": 20, "max_batch_tokens": 2048 } },
    { "route": "/embeddings/bulk", "continuous_batching": { "window_ms": 200, "max_batch_tokens": 16384 } }
  ]
}
```
Jamal (oncall): applied patch via control-plane: ctl plane apply-config --service batcher --file /tmp/batcher-patch.json  (deploy id: dp-87411). Rolling restart scheduled across 4 shards.
infra-bot: batcher config rollout started: dp-87411. Expected steady-state ~90s per shard.
Clara M.: after first shard went green: /v1/generate p95 dropped from 1.2s -> 420ms. Good.
Priya R.: To reduce impact on background customers, I'm also going to enable a traffic-shaper that biases small requests into small-batch pipeline. That keeps throughput for large embeddings jobs but reduces latency for low-latency calls.
Priya R.: snippets to enable feature-flag 'small-batch-fastpath':
```
ff-toggle --set small-batch-fastpath=true --scope global --reason "incident: reduce p95 for latency-sensitive routes"
```

Sasha: I will cut KV prefetch for embeddings/bulk: feature toggle kv-prefetch=false for org-scoped runs.
Jamal (oncall): Done. /ops-cli ff set --name kv-prefetch --org ACME-ops --value false
infra-bot: feature toggle applied, may take 10s to propagate.
Clara M.: metrics: queue depth normalized, overall token throughput down ~12% but p95 for latency routes down by ~60%. Customer ACME sees many of their bulk jobs slowed but not errored.
Priya R.: We should also notify customer success — this affects their reindex job. I'll draft a note.
Jamal (oncall): Handing off to Leo for overnight watch. If it flares again, escalate to platform-sre for capacity increase or roll back quota.
Leo G.: taking handoff. Notes:
- mitigation steps taken: org quota reduce, batcher window adjustments, small-batch-fastpath enabled, kv-prefetch off for ACME
- current state: p95 latency for generate/chat ~420-600ms, embeddings throughput reduced, job queueing back to normal
- next steps: monitor batcher.avg_wait_ms, router.queue_depth, and customer error rate for next 2 hours
Leo G.: starting watch now; will ping every 30m or sooner if it spikes.
Sasha: customer-success notified with the following summary: "We applied a temporary soft quota to reduce queueing and adjusted batching to favor latency-sensitive routes. Expect background reindex to run slower; we'll revert changes once traffic normalizes."
Clara M.: postmortem action items captured: 1) add per-org traffic-shaper UI in console 2) prebuilt runbook for live-batching tweaks 3) autoscaling rule for batcher shards when avg_wait_ms > 100ms
Jamal (oncall): closing incident channel. If anyone sees regressions, reopen thread or page oncall. :thumbsup:
Leo G.: :thumbsup: I'll update status page if anything changes.
incident-bot: Incident INC-4921 resolved (mitigated) by manual traffic shaping and batcher config changes. Closed at ts 1734569988
